name: datrapscallion-packages
description: The home for Ben's shared packages. Each folder here is one package; apps link it with file:../packages/<folder>.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @btkulka/proc-kit && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @btkulka/proc-kit && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
